access.detail: Public polling-place address branch exists separately from voter identity form. HTML form posts to /VoterView/VotingPlace/GetPollingPlaceOrVoteCentersByStreetKey and requires publisher StreetKey. Current source reader does not execute address-lookups.

limitations: Montgomery County county public bulk list fetch returned 403; this packet does not bypass that response.
Public lookup form bytes are evidence of the source door, not bulk polling-site records; acquire a working official current list/precinct publication for database-held coverage.
